posts.caption:
Saturdays Success 🤩
-
Let’s go again today 🔥
-
📸: @benjshootsvisuals

Day 2 ✅
WU: P11 
Race 1: P2 🔥
-
My 2nd World Championship Podium and what a way to do it! Great fun leading some laps and battling for the top positions. So proud of myself, my team, family and friends for achieving such an incredible result today. 
-
Lots of data gathered and opportunities to learn, I’m looking forward for another chance tomorrow 🔥. 
-
Thank you team @phrperformance ❤️

Day 1 ✅
FP: P6 
QP: P5 
-
Great start to our weekend here in Cremona! Starting where we left off in the test with good feelings and speed with the bike. Really happy to have achieved my best qualifying of the year. Initially, qualified P6, but with a penalty given to a rider in front we start from the middle of the 2nd row… 
-
We have the building blocks set to have a strong result tomorrow, but will keep working to find the extra step we need 💪🏻. 
-
Thank you to my @phrperformance Leon & Daniel for their hard work. Let’s push onwards to tomorrow!
